title: PlanResult
description: Everything the trace screen needs in one response: the scored hours it draws, the windows it ranks, and the constraint that closed the rest. No language model is involved in producing any of it.

fetched_at.description: When the forecast was retrieved. The client is required to show this — a forecast without a time on it is a lie.

stale.description: True when this was served from an expired cache because the upstream was unreachable.

hours.description: Every scored hour, in order. This is the trace.

windows.description: Contiguous runs that clear the threshold, best first.

blocker.description: The constraint that eliminated the most hours a person would actually have used, or null when nothing did.

excluded.description: Severe weather removed this hour outright, regardless of profile.

worst_penalty.description: Which constraint cost this hour the most, for explaining a low score without inventing a reason.

constraint.description: temperature, wind, precipitation, uv, or severe_weather. Never time_of_day — that is not weather.
